U.note: Clear but flat daytime globe with a stubby base and sparse top-heavy snow; plain staging.

V.note: Charming shelf-room setting and a globe that tilts on shake, though the glass is milky and the base reads slightly off.

W.note: Huge moody dome with good snowfall, but the base is a dark angular slab and the controls and text clip at the bottom.

X.note: Best glass, brass collar and wood base with a lit cabin and drifting glitter; the side panel and the stray rotating frame on shake distract.

Y.note: Polished night scene with moon, smoke, glowing windows and tidy staging; snow is sparse and settles quickly.

Z.note: Monochrome blue with a dim scene and blocky highlights; the glitter cloud swirls nicely but the cabin is washed out.
